newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian traders see short-term yields ease again.
newsitem.headline: Belgian traders see short-term yields ease again.

text.p: Belgian T-bill and short-term rates will slip again once the Belgian national bank's policy of reducing liquidity to bolster the franc will have lifted the currency, traders said on Thursday.
Three-month T-bills, still at 3.22/27 percent on Thursday, were at 3.27/39 on Thursday. The one-week repo rate was at 3.35/40 percent against 3.24/28 a day earlier.
"No panic. The BNB has reduced liquidity to support the franc, the same tactics they always use," one trader said. "It has always been a successful policy so they'll stick to it," another said.
